title: SAP Start Service and SAP Management Console store sensitive credential information in process memory… (CVE-2026-89115)
description: SAP Start Service and SAP Management Console store sensitive credential information in process memory without protection. An attacker with high privileges and local access could inspect the memory to recover these credentials and reuse them for authentication. This vulnerability impacts confidentiality but does not affect integrity or availability. The CVSS score is 4.4, indicating a medium severity level.
